 Sound familiar?
 Most Basingstoke sites look fine and bring in nothing 
 1 The problem
 You have had quotes that are hard to compare. Some agencies want a monthly retainer before they say what it buys. Your current site looks fine on a laptop but nobody finds it, and the enquiries it does bring are hard to track.
 2 What it costs you
 Basingstoke is a busy market, and buyers compare three or four firms on their phone before they call one. If your site is slow, vague on price or hard to contact from, you are not in that shortlist. That is work you never hear about.
 3 What changes
 A fast site with clear services, your areas and one obvious way to get in touch, set up for Google from the start. A fixed price you can budget for, and one person who answers when you call.

 Meet the builder
 You deal with Andy Norman 
 Andy spent more than 30 years in field service and managed print, from field engineer to service manager. He founded Antek Automation to build the websites and AI tools he wished local firms had.
 As a web designer for Basingstoke businesses, he is based in Andover, about 20 miles away. Most builds are done by phone and video, and meetings can be arranged.

 FAQ
 Questions Basingstoke firms ask 
 How much does a website cost in Basingstoke?
 £600 for a 5-page Starter site or £995 for an 8-page Core site, fixed. Extra pages are £125 each.
 Do you meet Basingstoke clients in person?
 Most of the build is done by phone and video. Meetings can be arranged; the office is in Andover, about 20 miles away.
 Should I pick Starter or Core?
 Starter suits a sole trader with a few services. Core suits a firm with several services or areas to show.
 Is SEO included?
 Every build includes technical SEO and schema. Ongoing local SEO is a separate monthly service.
 How long does a Basingstoke build take?
 From deposit to launch, allow 1 to 3 weeks.
 Who owns the finished site?
 You own the site once it is paid for.
 Know the price before you ring. Then ring.

 About this Basingstoke web design service
 Basingstoke Website Design is run by Antek Automation, a sole trader in Andover led by Andy Norman. It builds fixed-price sites for firms across Basingstoke, Chineham, Hook and Tadley, from £600 for five pages. Read how Antek builds websites for the wider service.

## https://basingstokewebsitedesign.co.uk/about-andy

Your web designer
 Andy Norman, web designer for Basingstoke firms 
 Andy Norman founded Antek Automation after more than 30 years in field service and managed print, working up from field engineer to service manager.
 That background is why a Basingstoke client gets a plain answer and a written price. He has sat on the customer side of a slow supplier, and he builds sites the way he wanted them bought.
 What working with Andy looks like
 You speak to the person writing and building your site at every stage. There are no account managers, and Andy is open about what one person can and cannot take on.
